beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Nicodemus was a ruler and a respected teacher, a man near the top of his world. And yet, one night, he slipped quietly through the dark streets to ask his questions in private, humble enough to come and learn.

timing.text: Nicodemus was a ruler and a respected teacher, a man near the top of his world.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: He came to the light and listened. And what he heard turned his careful world upside down. It was not a small adjustment or one more rule to keep. It was a whole new beginning — a person must be born all over again.

timing.text: He came to the light and listened.

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: Jesus answered and said unto him,

timing.text: Jesus answered and said unto him,

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.

timing.text: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: How can a man be born when he is old? can he enter the second time into his mother's womb, and be born?

timing.text: How can a man be born when he is old?
can he enter the second time into his mother's womb, and be born?

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Nicodemus took it literally, and was baffled. He could not picture it. Surely no one could climb back and start his life over from the beginning.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: But the new birth was never meant to be physical. To be born again is first to be born of water — to go down into the water of baptism and come up new, the old life washed away and left behind.

timing.text: But the new birth was never meant to be physical.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: And there was a second half to it, not water only. To be born of the Spirit is to receive the gift of the Holy Ghost — a birth from above, life breathed into the soul by heaven itself.

timing.text: And there was a second half to it, not water only.

Jesus answered,

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born of water and of the Spirit, he cannot enter into the kingdom of God.

timing.text: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born of water and of the Spirit, he cannot enter into the kingdom of God.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Here is the quiet study gem. Notice he did not say this was one good option among many. He said a person cannot enter without it. The gate is the gate — the same for everyone, even a learned and upright ruler like Nicodemus.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: And that same single gate still stands open before you: born of water, and born of the Spirit. The door is not hidden and it is not narrow with pride — it is simply the way in. When you stand before it, will you go through?

card.text: To enter the kingdom, a person must be born again — born of water in baptism, and of the Spirit from above. The gate is the gate, the same for everyone. When you stand before it, will you go through?
